name: Buy Your Way Into Heaven
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that no one can earn entrance into heaven through their own righteousness or works, as all our efforts are like filthy rags before a holy God (Isaiah 64:6). Salvation is found only through faith in Jesus Christ, who alone is the way to the Father and the source of eternal life (John 14:6; John 3:16). True entrance into the kingdom requires doing the will of God, which is believing in His Son, for there is no other name by which we can be saved (Matthew 7:21; Acts 4:12). Without faith in Christ, the wrath of God remains on the unbeliever (John 3:36).
